title: Life support needs working systems
record: Environmental Control and Life Support Systems
fact: On the International Space Station, life-support systems manage cabin air, oxygen, and water. Oxygen generation uses electricity to split water.
limits: This is ISS technology, not a specification for the fictional Moon outpost. Resource points are invented for learning.

title: An archived solar flare
fact: DONKI recorded an X3.9-class solar flare beginning at 06:27 UTC on 10 May 2024.
limits: An archived solar event is context for this practice scenario. It is not a Moon-base exposure measurement or a forecast. Safety points are invented.
units: Flare class X3.9; not a dose

title: Why shelter can matter
record: How NASA Will Protect Astronauts From Space Radiation at the Moon
fact: NASA describes temporary shielding and shelter as ways to protect crews during solar particle events.
limits: The game models a possible hazard. It does not claim this flare caused a specific dose at the Moon.

title: Plants need a controlled home
fact: The Canadian Space Agency lists light, water, air, temperature, and time to harvest among the needs to consider when choosing space crops.
limits: The fictional harvest sizes and timing are game balance points, not CSA experiment results. Communication timing is also simplified.
